title: Jurisdiction and Binding Opinion in Inter-Agency Disputes
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد والمبادئ القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Jurisdiction over inter-agency disputes
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the General Assembly (الجمعية العمومية) has jurisdiction to adjudicate disputes arising between ministries and public authorities. FAIL if the note does not state that the General Assembly has jurisdiction over disputes arising between ministries and public authorities.

criteria.title: Binding opinion on both parties
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the opinion of the General Assembly (الجمعية العمومية) in these disputes is binding on both parties. FAIL if the note does not state that the General Assembly's opinion in these disputes is binding on both parties.

criteria.title: Alternative to litigation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the General Assembly (الجمعية العمومية) is considered an alternative to the use of litigation (الدعوى القضائية) for resolving disputes between administrative bodies. FAIL if the note does not state that the General Assembly is an alternative to litigation for resolving disputes between administrative bodies.

criteria.title: Right to appoint expert
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the General Assembly (الجمعية العمومية) has the right to appoint one or more experts to prepare the dispute so that it is fit for adjudication. FAIL if the note does not state that the General Assembly has the right to appoint one or more experts to prepare the dispute so that it is fit for adjudication.

criteria.title: Purpose of expert appointment
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the purpose of appointing the expert is to scrutinize documents and seek technical opinion in order to arrive at the truth. FAIL if the note does not state that the purpose of appointing the expert is to scrutinize documents and seek technical opinion in order to arrive at the truth.

review.notes: Verified C-001 through C-005 against Article 66(d) of State Council Law No. 47 of 1972 and General Assembly jurisprudence on binding inter-agency dispute resolution, litigation substitution, and expert appointment.
